deceit.title: Обман
deceit.emblem: A coiled snake raised to strike, its body in thick loops. The red accent is its forked tongue.

mercy.title: Пощада
mercy.emblem: A sword in its scabbard, the hilt tied to the scabbard with a cord so it cannot be drawn. The red accent is the cord.

blood.title: Кровь
blood.emblem: A heavy woodcutter's axe driven into a chopping block. The red accent is a strip of cloth wound round the haft.

gold.title: Золото
gold.emblem: A set of iron merchant's scales with a small heap of coins in one pan. The red accent is a tassel hanging from the beam.

word.title: Слово
word.emblem: A rolled parchment scroll tied with a cord. The red accent is the cord's knot.

theft.title: Кража
theft.emblem: An opened iron padlock with a bent lockpick still in its keyhole. The red accent is a scrap of cloth tied to the lockpick.

oath.title: Клятва
oath.emblem: Two hands clasped in a firm handshake, seen from the side, sleeves at the wrists. The red accent is a cord wound round the joined hands.

survival.title: Выживание
survival.emblem: A small campfire of three crossed logs ringed by stones. The red accent is the flame.
